title: Little Says
description: Simon Says, called by the TV and judged by its camera. Two players stand in front of the TV and follow "Little says… left arm up!", but move on a command without "Little says" and you lose a life. Everyone else bets on their phone who survives.
prompt: Hand-written camera game: AI-called Simon Says for up to 2 players via motion_start (arm-raise, both-arms-raise), audience bets on phones.
